LanguageData.JoyRescue.Settings.PendingRestart: Some changes take effect the next time RimWorld starts. Creating a type, and moving a building to another type, both have to be written before the game builds its per-colonist recreation tolerance tables — there is no way to do either mid-session.
LanguageData.JoyRescue.Settings.SaveHint: Types created here will exist the next time RimWorld starts. RimWorld writes a mod's settings when its window closes; "Save now" does the same thing immediately, if you would rather see it confirmed.
LanguageData.JoyRescue.Settings.ModeTip:
How the colonist reaches the building.
Stand on its spot — they walk onto the cell the building declares, like a telescope or a piano. Sit facing it — they take an adjacent cell and turn towards it, like a chess table. Watch from afar — they sit a few paces back and look at it, like a television.
Auto picks from the shape of the building. Click to cycle.
